Vendored in JackID (wave 83): all 7 clips (chimes, echo1, echo2, locate, sonar, spell, success).
Modified: trimmed to the sound, resampled to 22.05 kHz, peak-normalised, faded, saved as 16-bit WAV.
Registered for the gods' blessings feature (docs/BLESSINGS.md): boonOffer, boonPick, omen, spell, divineEcho.
